Author: jakeywunder (based on Hunty by Infi)
Name: Hunting Log Plus
Description:
Builds map flags, sorting and a full to-do list into the game's Hunting Log, so you can track down your targets without opening a separate window.

+ Click a monster's icon to flag it on your map
+ Shift+Click to also teleport to the nearest aetheryte (needs the Teleporter plugin)
+ Click a dungeon monster's icon to open its dungeon in the Duty Finder
+ Tick 'All remaining' to list every target you still need in one place
+ Sort that list by zone, by rank, or by what is nearest to you
+ Optionally flag the next nearest target automatically when you finish one

Inspired by Hunty by Infi, which the monster data also comes from.
A big thank you to KamiToolKit by MidoriKami for the native UI.
Punchline: Map flags, sorting and a to-do list, built into the Hunting Log.
